title.en: the fil book fair opens its 40th edition.
title.de: die fil buchmesse startet in ihre 40. ausgabe.

line.en: more than 3,000 activities, italy as guest of honour, rushdie and baricco among the writers. the public gets in from 09:00 to 21:00.
line.de: über 3.000 veranstaltungen, italien als ehrengast, unter anderem rushdie und baricco. der öffentliche eintritt ist von 09:00 bis 21:00.
line.tr: 3.000'den fazla etkinlik, konuk ülke italya, yazarlar arasında rushdie ve baricco var. halka giriş 09:00 ile 21:00 arası.

sparks.why: FIL Guadalajara 2026, edition 40, 28 nov to 6 dec (informador.mx, letralia.com); public admission 09:00 to 21:00 on 28 and 29 nov per informador. The opening ceremony is by invitation only.
